stories.title: LHC summons Punjab home secretary, Kot Lakhpat jail superintendent in plea seeking release of Imran’s sisters
stories.brief: LAHORE: The Lahore High Court (LHC) on Thursday summoned the Punjab home secretary and the superintendent of Kot Lakhpat jail in connection with a petition seeking the release of former prime minister Imran Khan’s three sisters.

stories.title: LHC summons Punjab home secretary, Kot Lakhpat Jail chief over Imran's sisters' detention
stories.brief: The Lahore High Court (LHC) on Thursday summoned the Punjab home secretary and the superintendent of Kot Lakhpat Jail over the continued detention of Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI) founder Imran Khan’s three sisters despite the expiry of their 30-day detention orders.

stories.title: What is PHP and why did it spark a global cyber-security scramble?
stories.brief: AI uncovered long-hidden programming flaws, triggering a rare global cyber-security response.

stories.title: Why is Elon Musk plotting a mega-merger of SpaceX and Tesla?
stories.brief: Musk says there's "a lot to be gained" by combining the firms in what would be the biggest merger in history.

stories.title: Why is a peat fire so bad? BBC is in Indonesia to find out
stories.brief: The BBC's Liza Tambunan is in central Kalimantan, to explain what peat is and why Indonesia is facing its worst wildfire season in a decade.

stories.title: Elon Musk confirms he is considering merging Tesla and SpaceX
stories.brief: Musk says special committees within both companies have been formed to look at a possible mega-merger.

stories.title: Karachi judicial magistrate rejects bail plea of anchorperson Iqrarul Hassan
stories.brief: KARACHI: A local court on Thursday rejected TV anchorperson Iqrarul Hassan’s bail plea in a cybercrime case pertaining to the alleged dissemination of anti-state content. Earlier this week, Hassan was sent to prison on judicial remand after the NCCIA sought an extension of his physical remand by another eight days.

stories.title: Govt directs ministries to compile civil servants' foreign nationality declarations
stories.brief: Under Rule 3(3), civil servants must declare whether they hold the nationality of any foreign country, possess foreign travel documents or are married to a foreign national.

stories.title: Karachi court rejects Iqrarul Hassan's bail plea in anti-state content case
stories.brief: The District and Sessions Court East dismissed a petition challenging Hassan's physical remand, with the defence counsel questioning the legality of the proceedings and arguing that the case concerned digital and cyber matters. The National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency (NCCIA) registered the case against Hassan, who is currently in jail on judicial remand.

stories.title: President Zardari to visit Germany from Oct 22-24: FO
stories.brief: Germany is Pakistan’s largest trading partner in the European Union, with both countries seeking to expand trade, investment and business cooperation.

stories.title: Pakistan, EU agree to boost counterterrorism cooperation, tackle online radicalisation: FO
stories.brief: The two sides reviewed recent regional and global developments affecting the terrorism threat landscape and strongly condemned terrorism in all its forms, reaffirming their commitment to combating the threat. The EU delegation condemned recent terrorist attacks in Pakistan, expressed solidarity with the victims and acknowledged Islamabad’s efforts to counter terrorism, the Foreign Office said.

stories.title: Pakistan to host UN conference on space technology for disaster warnings, climate action: SUPARCO
stories.brief: The United Nations–Pakistan International Conference on Leveraging Space Technology for Early Warning for All (EW4All), Climate Action and Disaster Risk Assessment will be held at the Serena Hotel. Discussions will also cover the use of space technology in disaster risk reduction, climate-resilient development and the monitoring of water resources, agriculture, forests and environmental change.

stories.title: IMF forecasts 1.3% contraction in Pakistan, 6.6% growth in 2027
stories.brief: The International Monetary Fund said the region's output was expected to contract by 1.3% as a result of the war's ​impact on energy production, shipping, tourism, trade and confidence.

stories.title: PM Shehbaz defends emergency, governor’s rule in K-P, blames PTI for resurgence of terrorism
stories.brief: He said provincial security forces had not been provided with adequate training, modern weapons or other necessary equipment, adding that the federal government had repeatedly assured PTI-led provincial administrations of its support in combating terrorism.

stories.title: Govt, JI negotiating committees to meet over petroleum levy tomorrow
stories.brief: The government and Jamaat-e-Islami (JI) negotiating committees are set to meet in Islamabad on Friday to discuss the abolition of the petroleum levy, as the party prepares to resume nationwide protests over fuel prices, JI Deputy Emir Liaquat Baloch said on Thursday.
